svg.text: ONE ACCESSIBLE COPY, TWO TEXT BRANCHES.
ROOT PRESERVES SPACES AND LINE BREAKS.
FONT, LINE-HEIGHT AND WIDTH ARE CALLER-OWNED.
CHARACTER MODE KEEPS EACH WORD TOGETHER.
SPACES / TABS / NEWLINES DO NOT ANIMATE.
NO-BREAK SPACE DOES NOT SPLIT A WORD.
CSS STARTS ON FIRST PAINT; ONE ENTRANCE.
CHANGING TEXT REMOUNTS THE VISUAL RUN.
REDUCED MOTION SHOWS ALL TEXT AT ONCE.
NO MOTION RUNTIME OR CLIENT STATE.
SCHEMATIC · SLOT WIDTHS ARE NOT GLYPH ADVANCES
DASHED WORD GROUPS · HUG · INLINE-BLOCK / NOWRAP
ROOT: DEFAULT SPAN; CALLER MAY CHOOSE A HEADING OR PARAGRAPH.
ALL WORDS SHARE ONE SEQUENCE INDEX; NEW LINES DO NOT RESET IT.
PROPORTIONAL SCHEMATIC · PLANE SEPARATION IS ILLUSTRATIVE
SR-ONLY IS A SIBLING OF THE VISUAL RUN.
IT RETAINS THE COMPLETE STRING ONCE.
WORD MODE SKIPS THE INNER CHARACTER WRAPPERS.
NO PANEL, BORDER, RADIUS OR SHADOW IS ADDED.
EM-BASED BLUR AND RISE · TRANSFORM DOES NOT CHANGE LINE FLOW
REST: FILTER NONE; TRANSLATE NONE; NO PERSISTENT BLUR.
DEFAULT N > 1 · D = 0 · TIMELINE IS NORMALIZED
dᵢ = D + i·S; S = P/(N−1); E = D + (N−1)·S + T
blur-text.tsx; cn.ts; globals.css; registry + demo + tests.
1 demo, 3 shared usage examples, 6 behavior tests surveyed.
Live demo: F = 36px; LH ≈ 40px; W = 448px; 3 lines.
Observed values are caller choices, not component constraints.
WORD: ONE SEGMENT PER NON-SPACE PART.
SPLIT: ASCII SPACE, TAB, NEWLINE ONLY.
NON-BREAKING SPACE STAYS INSIDE A WORD.
WHITESPACE DOES NOT ADVANCE INDEX i.
THE SLOW TOKEN CONTROLS SEGMENT DURATION.
NO WIDTH ANIMATION; NO GLYPH METRIC CONTRACT.
